title: EventPulse Stage 3 - Correctness (duplicates)

panels.title: Duplicates by layer (S3-F3): every duplicate is counted where it was stopped
Stopped at the API (replayed, $__range)
panels.description: Same key, same payload, already done: answered with the original result, nothing produced.

panels.title: Stopped at the sink (reprocessed, $__range)
panels.description: Offset already stored once: consumer crash, rebalance, offset reset.

panels.title: Stopped at the sink (redelivered, $__range)
panels.description: New offset, key already stored: a duplicate that got past the API (window expired, Redis lost, fail_open, API crash, replay).

panels.title: Conflicting content ($__range)
panels.description: Same (tenant, event_id), different content: a producer bug. Counted, never overwritten.

panels.title: Duplicates per second, by layer and cause
panels.description: Stacked. A retry storm upstream shows up here even when storage stays correct.

panels.title: Requests by idempotency result
panels.description: new | replayed | in_progress (409) | payload_mismatch (422) | fail_open | fail_closed | disabled

panels.title: fail_open ($__range)
panels.description: Accepted WITHOUT API dedup because Redis was unreachable or full (policy open). The sink still dedups.

panels.title: fail_closed ($__range)
panels.description: Rejected with 503 because Redis was unreachable (policy closed).

panels.title: Complete failures ($__range)
panels.description: Produced but the key could not be marked done (Redis error / lost ownership): retries get 409 until the inflight TTL.

panels.title: Redis memory used vs limit
panels.description: When used reaches maxmemory, new keys fail and the API runs in fail_open/fail_closed. Size: ~276 B x events/s x IDEM_TTL_S (ADR 0004).

panels.title: Sink (layer 2, Postgres key: the source of truth)
Reprocessed messages by partition
panels.description: Messages whose offset was already stored once (crash between DB commit and offset commit, rebalance, reset).

panels.title: DLQ size (not replayed)
panels.description: dlq_meta rows not replayed yet (one per source record).

panels.title: DLQ duplicates ($__range)
panels.description: Dead letters published again for a source record already indexed (crash between DLQ publish and offset commit).

panels.title: Retry rate-limited chunks ($__range)
panels.description: Chunks paused because too many records wanted a retry tier (RETRY_MAX_RATE_PER_S): a retry storm being contained.

panels.title: Retry tier traffic: published vs processed
panels.description: Amplification: processed next_tier / published. A permanent error misclassified as transient shows up as next_tier then dlq (C9).

panels.title: Retry lag p99 (ran after not_before) and paused partitions
Chunk failures by reason (paused / retried)
panels.description: db_unavailable / registry_unavailable = paused (never DLQ); retry_rate_limited = a storm contained.

panels.title: DLQ replay (S3-F6): last executed tools/dlq-replay run (textfile collector)
Replay success rate (last run)
panels.description: ep_dlq_replay_replayed / ep_dlq_replay_selected of the last executed replay. Skipped records (pre-check, loop guard) count against it on purpose: they still need a fix.

panels.title: Replayed / selected (last run)
panels.description: Dead letters re-injected (acked) vs selected by the last executed replay.

panels.title: Skipped / failed (last run)
panels.description: Skipped by the pre-check or the loop guard, plus failed (missing in the DLQ topic, produce error).

panels.title: Last replay run
panels.description: When the last executed replay finished (red if it did not finish with status done).

panels.title: Transactional outbox (S3-F4): tenant config changes -> config.changed
Unpublished outbox rows
panels.description: Committed changes not published yet (count on the partial index). Should hover near 0.

panels.title: Oldest unpublished age
panels.description: Rising = relay stuck or Kafka down: docs/runbooks/outbox-stuck.md.

panels.title: Active relays (leader)
panels.description: Exactly 1 in RELAY_MODE=single. 0 = nobody publishes; 2 = multi mode (C8) or a split brain.

panels.title: Republished (attempts > 1), range
panels.description: Upper bound on duplicates the relay sent (crash between publish and mark, Kafka errors). Consumers dedup on event_id.

panels.title: Outbox published / republished per second
panels.description: Published = acked by Kafka and marked. Republished = published with attempts > 1. Failed cycles = rolled back (Kafka/Postgres down), backed off with jitter.

panels.title: Publish latency (commit -> published)
panels.description: created_at -> published_at of each row. Poll interval + LISTEN wake-up + produce ack.

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Unpublished rows and the oldest age over time: the outage signature is both rising together.

panels.title: Admin config PUTs by result
panels.description: ok / invalid (400) / not_found / precondition_failed (412: stale If-Match) / unavailable (503) / error.

panels.title: Event time (S3-F8): late and out-of-order events are stored; lateness and skew rejections
Lateness (received_at - occurred_at)
panels.description: How late client events arrive. API = accepted requests; sink = rows actually stored (retries and replays included, with their original received_at). Log scale: seconds to days.

panels.title: Clock-skew rejections and clients ahead
panels.description: 422 occurred_at_in_future / occurred_at_too_old per second, and accepted events whose clock is ahead of the server (within OCCURRED_AT_MAX_FUTURE_S).

description: S3-F3: duplicates are counted and visible at every layer (API idempotency, sink by cause, conflicts). Import into Grafana; datasource uid 'prometheus'.
